sharedPrompt: A seamless terrain texture for a dark, semi-realistic painted isometric game set in 1870s Japan. Match the supplied approved snow high-ground image's cool muted off-white and blue-grey snow materials and the forest-floor reference's fine ground-detail scale. STRICT ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP-DOWN, camera straight down at 90 degrees, not an isometric scene. One continuous flat walkable ground surface filling an opaque 1024 by 1024 PNG, no transparency. Fine natural painted detail, diffuse overcast illumination, restrained contrast, no baked directional cast shadows. All opposite edges must continue naturally for seamless tiling. No borders, frames, text, vignette, edge fading, tile grids, roads, footprints, characters, buildings, trees, crowns, branches, standing rocks, cliff faces, horizon or large central focal motif. Avoid lines, stripes, rows and strongly recognizable shapes that reveal repetition across a large region.

items.label: Snow-covered lowland ground
items.detailPrompt: An almost continuous blanket of settled lowland snow, approximately 90 to 95 percent snow coverage. Subtle wind-softened grain, gentle irregular shallow depressions, sparse tiny dark pebbles and occasional short dormant grass tips barely breaking the surface. Mostly calm open snow, no deep dramatic drifts, exposed rock slabs, pine tops or mountainous features. Small details distributed naturally and quietly, consistent scale across the image. This must read as snowy terrain beneath walking human-sized units rather than a miniature mountain landscape.
